# Reference decoder

`bcdec.h` is the unchanged upstream file from
[iOrange/bcdec](https://github.com/iOrange/bcdec/blob/80859ed3b7afb1c527a2a99d70c61457bea72d0c/bcdec.h),
commit `80859ed3b7afb1c527a2a99d70c61457bea72d0c`. Its MIT/Unlicense text is
included in the header. `../ocarina-bc-reference.c` is the small independent SDK
runner; Coax owns the native texture layout, bounds and component mapping.
